messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered by error-rate spike on routing-service (policy-service:deploy-2026-03-15). Priority: high. Thread created 1798500001.
PagerDuty: Paging Dinesh (oncall) — acknowledgement required.
Dinesh: acked. I'm on it, joining. what's the impact?
Support: customers reporting hallucinated responses and timeouts when model selection falls back (observed across eu-west and us-west). High-volume customers: acme-inc, finlytics. Errors look like: `wrong_variant_returned` and `cache_miss_then_stale_kv`.
Carla: I see a surge in routing fallback loops in the metrics dashboard — requests bounce between us-west-a and eu-west-b variants. Latency increases and KV cache hits drop to ~12% from 78%.
Alice: quick hypothesis: new fallback policy rollout includes region tag in KV prefix key. That would make KV lookup inconsistent when routing swaps region, causing both cache misses and accidental reuse of wrong variant entries.
Ben: I can confirm from logs: `routing_decision` shows policy_id=pf-204, rule: `prefer_cost_then_region`, and kv_prefix computed as `model:${model_id}:region:${region}:kv`. Old prefix was `model:${model_id}:variant:${variant}:kv`. Example log: `{req_id:abc123, model:gpt-neox-2B, region:eu-west-b, kv_key: model:gpt-neox-2B:region:us-west-a:kv, cached_variant: us-west-a}`.
Dinesh: ok immediate mitigation steps?
Carla: stop rollout of pf-204 on the policy service. Set policy-service to previous stable policy.
Dinesh: doing now. `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/policy-service/rollout/stop -d '{"policy_id":"pf-204"}'` -> 200.
Incident Bot: deploy-flag pf-204 rollback requested by Dinesh.
ML Platform: also toggled `routing.kv_prefix_mode=variant` in runtime config for prod via feature flag. Command: `redwood-admin set-config --env=prod routing.kv_prefix_mode=variant --source=incidence-hotfix`.
Ben: before we unroll cache, need to prevent contamination: we should TTL or segregate the keys created with the wrong prefix to avoid mixing. Suggest: create a short-lived namespace alias and run a bulk rename or redirect. But simpler: flush wrong-prefix keys only.
Alice: I ran a safe scan: `redis-cli --scan --pattern "model:*:region:*:kv" | wc -l` -> 4321 keys. We'll delete only keys older than 5m and mark request router to bypass KV for 2m.
Eva: I'll hit support playbook for customers. ETA to bypass KV and stop routing loop: ~3m.
Dinesh: switching router to KV-bypass mode: `POST /control/router/bypass_kv?duration=120` -> 202 accepted.
Carla: router metrics show loops dropping immediately, latency spiking down from 2.8s -> 0.9s P95. KV hits now ~3% (expected while bypassing).
Support: notifying acme-inc and finlytics: "We're aware of intermittent wrong-model responses and timeouts; we've applied a temporary mitigation and will follow up."
Ben: running deletion job: `redis-cli --scan --pattern "model:*:region:*:kv" | xargs -n 100 redis-cli del` (throttled). Deletion rate ~500/s.
Dinesh: also running a BQ query to enumerate impacted requests: `SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM routing_logs WHERE error_type IN ('wrong_variant_returned','cache_miss_then_stale_kv') AND ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() GROUP BY customer_id;`
Alice: early results: acme-inc=241 errors, finlytics=97, others small.
Incident Bot: note: change-collection: policy pf-204 rollback, runtime flag routing.kv_prefix_mode=variant, router KV-bypass (120s), redis wrong-prefix key purge initiated.
Eva: Can we verify no data leak happened (i.e., responses from wrong tenant/origin)?
Ben: scanned logs for cross-tenant indicators -> none found so far. Wrong variant responses are model-outputs only, not cross-customer data.
Carla: recommend we keep KV bypass until all wrong-prefix keys are purged + a conservative cooldown 10m. After that re-enable KV and monitor.
Dinesh: agreed. set cooldown 10m. I'll own postmortem and customer comms. Can someone capture exact rollout diff that introduced region into prefix?
Alice: policy diff: 
```
- kv_prefix: "model:${model_id}:variant:${variant}:kv"
+ kv_prefix: "model:${model_id}:region:${region}:kv"
```
Also policy rule added region fallback weight change: `region_weight: 0.7` (previously 0.0).
Dinesh: assign postmortem to Carla/Alice/Ben, impact: partial for select customers, severity: Sev2.
Support: logged cases with customers and escalation.
ML Platform: verifying rollout tooling to ensure policy templates are validated against kv_prefix invariants. Adding a pre-deploy lint rule: `kv_prefix` must include either `variant` or `model` but not `region`.
Incident Bot: incident marked mitigated at 1798500442 — router loops stopped, rollback complete, wrong-prefix keys largely purged. Postmortem owner: Dinesh.
Dinesh: thanks team. follow-up: postmortem draft by EOD, customer follow-up mail queued for tomorrow with timeline and remediation steps. :thumbsup:
Carla: will add metric alerts to detect KV prefix divergence (compare configured prefix vs observed cache keys) and create a canary that simulates cross-region routing to catch this earlier.
Alice: also adding unit tests for policy-template linter and a non-regression test for KV key namespace.
Ben: leaving a note: if we re-enable region-aware fallbacks, implement explicit canonicalization of kv keys to include canonical-variant id.
Support: closing customer tickets provisionally; will reopen if we see new errors.
Incident Bot: final: severity downgraded to monitoring. Logs and actions archived under incident/1798500001.
